chosen_rendering: After him Bani son of Enadad repaired a second measure, from house of Azaria to the angle and to the turning.
alternate_renderings: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And one shall rise from Jacob and destroy the survivor from the city.
alternate_renderings: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remains of the city.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sea shall thunder with its fullness, and tree of field and all things in it.
alternate_renderings: Let the sea roar, and the fullness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the servants of Saoul report these words to David, and the word was made straight in the eyes of David, to become son-in-law to the king.
alternate_renderings: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And all who traded through the gate of their city listened to Emmor and Sychem his son, and every male was circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin.
alternate_renderings: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: These are those whom Moses gave as inheritance beyond the Jordan in Araboth of Moab, beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho from the east.
alternate_renderings: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jektan begot Elmodad and Saleth and Sarmoth and Jarach and Odorra and Aibel and Decla,
alternate_renderings: And Joktan brings forth Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: let your ear now be attentive and your eyes open to hear prayer of your servant which I pray before you today, day and night, concerning sons of Israel your servants, and I confess over sins of sons of Israel, which we sinned against you; both I and house of my father sinned.
alternate_renderings: Let yours ear now be attentive, and yours eyes open, that you may hear the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you now, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against you: both I and my father's house have sinned.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saoul added still more to stand in awe from before David.
alternate_renderings: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and let him give me the double cave, which belongs to him, which is in part of his field. Let him give it to me among you for full silver as a burial holding.
alternate_renderings: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace among you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Caleb went up from there against those dwelling in Dabir; now the former name of Dabir was City of Letters.
alternate_renderings: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: their count was eight thousand five hundred eighty.
alternate_renderings: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: These are the clans of Judah by their enrollment, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
alternate_renderings: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the saying appeared evil in the eyes of Saoul because of this word, and he said, To David they gave the tens of thousands, and to me they gave the thousands.
alternate_renderings: And Saul was very angry, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they made the two emerald stones clasped and encircled in gold, engraved and carved like the carving of a seal, with the names of the sons of Israel.
alternate_renderings: And he made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the clasps: so it became one tabernacle.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you found his heart faithful before you and made covenant with him, to give to him land of the Canaanites and Hittites and Amorites and Perizzites and Iebousites and Gergesaites, and to his seed, and you established your words, because you are righteous.
alternate_renderings: And found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and have performed your words; for you are righteous:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: On two witnesses or on three witnesses the one dying shall die. He shall not die on one witness.
alternate_renderings: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Their horses were 736, their mules 245,
alternate_renderings: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and every raven and those like it,
alternate_renderings: Every raven after his kind;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of Kariathiarim, Kaphira, and Beroth: 743.
alternate_renderings: The children of Kirjatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the first blow that Iōnathan and the one carrying his equipment struck was about twenty men, with darts and sling-stones and field-pebbles.
alternate_renderings: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armour bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: surely they shall not see the land that I swore to their fathers. But their children who are here with me, as many as do not know good or evil, every young inexperienced one, to these I will give the land. But all who provoked me shall not see it.
alternate_renderings: Surely they shall not see the land which I swore unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And their counting by their clans, by the houses of their fathers, was three thousand two hundred.
alternate_renderings: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: If it gores a son or a daughter, they shall do to him according to this ordinance.
alternate_renderings: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And to Benjamin he said, Beloved by the Lord, he shall dwell trusting, and God overshadows him all the days, and he rested between his shoulders.
alternate_renderings: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: sons of Basaloth, sons of Maouda, sons of Aresa,
alternate_renderings: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: sons of Basaloth, sons of Meida, sons of Adasan,
alternate_renderings: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because he treated the Lord's word as worthless and scattered his commands, that person shall be utterly destroyed. His sin is in him.
alternate_renderings: Because he has despised the word of the LORD, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because of this the priests of Dagon and everyone entering the house of Dagon do not step upon the step of the house of Dagon in Azotus until this day, because in passing over they pass over it.
alternate_renderings: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon, nor any that come into Dagon's house, tread on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod unto this day.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: A man shall come out from his seed and shall rule many nations, and his kingdom shall be exalted above Gog, and his kingdom shall be increased.
alternate_renderings: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Rejoice, O heavens, together with him, and let all sons of God worship him. Rejoice, O nations, with his people, and let all angels of God strengthen themselves in him, because he avenges the blood of his sons and will exact vengeance and repay justice to enemies, and to those hating him he will repay, and the Lord will cleanse the land of his people.
alternate_renderings: Rejoice, O all of you nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of Netopha: 56.
alternate_renderings: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The singers: sons of Asaph, 128.
alternate_renderings: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And on the lampstand four almond-shaped bowls, with its knobs and its lilies.
alternate_renderings: And in the candlesticks shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The gatekeepers: sons of Saloum, sons of Ater, sons of Telmon, sons of Akoub, sons of Atita, sons of Sabi, 138.
alternate_renderings: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: All the nethinim and sons of servants of Salomon: 392.
alternate_renderings: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because in faithfulness there were four mighty gatekeepers. The Levites were over the storerooms and over the treasuries of the house of God.
alternate_renderings: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And on the day when you bring the sheaf, you shall prepare an unblemished yearling lamb as a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
alternate_renderings: And all of you shall offer that day when all of you wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And I did not believe those speaking to me until I came and my eyes saw. And behold, it is not even half according to what they reported to me. You have added goodness to all the report that I heard in my land.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: your wisdom and prosperity exceeds the fame which I heard.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: All the clans of Sami by their enrollment were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
alternate_renderings: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jacob ate and was filled, and the beloved kicked. He grew fat, he became thick, he broadened out, and he abandoned God who made him and withdrew from God his savior.
alternate_renderings: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: you are becoming fat, you are grown thick, you are covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he shall bring one from all his gifts as a contribution to the Lord. It shall belong to the priest who pours out the blood of the sacrifice of salvation.
alternate_renderings: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: But the word appeared very hard before Abraham concerning his son.
alternate_renderings: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they said to the king, The man brought us to an end and pursued us, he who schemed to wipe us out. Let us destroy him from having any standing in all the border of Israel.
alternate_renderings: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the foreigners lined up for battle against Israel, and the battle turned, and a man of Israel stumbled before the foreigners, and four thousand men were struck down in battle in the field.
alternate_renderings: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And at dedication of wall of Ierousalem they sought the Levites in their places, to bring them into Ierousalem to make dedication and rejoicing, in thanksgiving and in songs, with cymbals and stringed instruments and lyres.
alternate_renderings: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And all the warrior people with him went up, and going they came opposite the city from the east.
alternate_renderings: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: A prostitute and a profaned woman they shall not take, and a woman cast out from her husband they shall not take, because he is holy to the Lord his God.
alternate_renderings: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And sons of Asana built the Fish Gate. They roofed it and set its doors, its bolts, and its bars.
alternate_renderings: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Moses said to God, 'Look, I will come to the sons of Israel and say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you. And they will ask me, What is his name? What should I say to them?'
alternate_renderings: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers has sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of the sons of Manasseh went from the sons of Israel from Shiloh in the land of Canaan to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their possession which they inherited by command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
alternate_renderings: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Lord God of Israel chose me from all house of my father to be king over Israel forever, and in Iouda he chose kingdom, and from house of Iouda house of my father, and among sons of my father he desired in me to make me king over all Israel.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he has chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel and went out to war, and the Lord gave Chousarsathōm king of Syria into his hand, and his hand grew strong over Chousarsathōm.
alternate_renderings: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And a calf or sheep cut in ear or short in tail, you shall make them as slaughter-offerings for yourself, but for your vow it shall not be accepted.
alternate_renderings: Either a bullock or a lamb that has any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that may you offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: sons of Labano, sons of Agaba, sons of Akaboth,
alternate_renderings: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the man Elkana went up, and all his house, to sacrifice in Shilōm the sacrifice of the days and his vows and all the tithes of his land.
alternate_renderings: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Except to the tribe of Levi no inheritance was given. The Lord God of Israel, this one is their inheritance, just as the Lord said to them. And this is the division that Moses divided to the sons of Israel in Araboth of Moab, beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho.
alternate_renderings: Only unto the tribes of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And he said, Hearken all of you, all Judah, and all of you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you king Jehoshaphat, Thus says the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: stag and gazelle and buffalo and goat-deer and pygarg and oryx and giraffe.
alternate_renderings: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: heads of fathers: two hundred forty-two. And Amessai son of Esdriēl,
alternate_renderings: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And there was still war in Geth, and there was oversized man, and his fingers were six and six, twenty-four, and he was descendant of giants.
alternate_renderings: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot and he also was the son of the giant.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from Danites, drawing up for battle, twenty-eight thousand eight hundred.
alternate_renderings: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And I will be blameless with him, and I will keep myself from my lawlessness.
alternate_renderings: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the boundary of the sons of Manasseh came to be Delanath, which is opposite the sons of Anath, and the boundary goes to Jamin and Jassib to the spring of Thaphthoth.
alternate_renderings: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lies before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and its set-apart lands, and Gatheth and its set-apart lands,
alternate_renderings: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Behold, son is born to you. He shall be man of rest, and I will give him rest from all enemies around, because Salomon shall be his name, and peace and quietness I will give upon Israel in his days.
alternate_renderings: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And your holy Sabbath you made known to them, and by hand of Moses your servant you commanded to them commandments and ordinances and law.
alternate_renderings: And made known unto them your holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses your servant:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and from the sea Hierakon, the boundary near Joppa.
alternate_renderings: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And the LORD spoke unto you out of the midst of the fire: all of you heard the voice of the words, but saw no embodiment; only all of you heard a voice.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Ieremias and Ieziēl and Ioanan and Iozabad the Gadarathite,

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall be holy, because I, the Lord your God, am holy.
alternate_renderings: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be all of you holy: for I am the LORD your God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: saying, Whenever your sons ask you, saying, What are these stones?
alternate_renderings: And he spoke unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Food for silver you shall give me and I shall eat, and water for silver you shall give me and I shall drink, except that I shall pass through on foot,
alternate_renderings: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from the Levites: Samaia son of Asoub, son of Ezri,
alternate_renderings: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and the holy garments of Aaron the priest and the garments in which they shall minister, and the tunics for Aaron's sons for the priesthood, and the anointing oil and the compounded incense."
alternate_renderings: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And these are the sons of Ephraim: of Suthala, the clan of the Suthalaite; of Tanach, the clan of the Tanachite.
alternate_renderings: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And fire from the Lord fell from heaven and devoured the whole burnt offering and the split wood and the water in the trench, and the fire licked up the stones and the dust.
alternate_renderings: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The singers: sons of Asaph, 148.
alternate_renderings: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And what you did not ask I have given you too, both riches and glory, so that no man like you has come to be among kings.
alternate_renderings: And I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto you all your days.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: With leavened loaves he shall bring his gifts with the sacrifice of praise of salvation.
alternate_renderings: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And when he finished speaking all these words, the earth beneath them was torn open.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and destroying he will destroy from before our face the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Pherezite and the Hivite and the Amorite and the Gergesite and the Jebusite.
alternate_renderings: And Joshua said, Hereby all of you shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And these are the sons of Asar: Balaam and Zoukam and Joukam.
alternate_renderings: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the chief over the chiefs of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, appointed to keep the charges of the holy things.
alternate_renderings: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from the poor of the land the chief guard left some for vinedressers and field-workers.
alternate_renderings: But the captain of the guard left of the door of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if your heart turns away and you do not listen, and being led astray you bow to other gods and serve them,
alternate_renderings: But if yours heart turn away, so that you will not hear, but shall be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Be strong and become men, foreigners, lest you serve the Hebrews as they served us. And become men and fight them.
alternate_renderings: Be strong and quit yourselves like men, O all of you Philistines, that all of you be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Birth-pangs of death encircled me; hardnesses of death came before me.
alternate_renderings: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because sin is divination, and pain and grief bring on teraphim, because you counted the word of the Lord as nothing, and the Lord will count you as nothing from being king over Israel.
alternate_renderings: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, he has also rejected you from being king.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Achiel household steward, and Eliab son of Saph over the family line, and Adoniram son of Ephra over the levies,
alternate_renderings: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of testimony, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, saying,
alternate_renderings: And the LORD spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the man hurried and came near to Heli and said to him, I am the one coming from the camp, and I fled from the battle line today. And he said, What is the matter, child?
alternate_renderings: And the man said unto Eli, I am he that came out of the army, and I fled to day out of the army. And he said, What is there done, my son?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you will do it a third time and inspect, and you will come to your place where you hid on the working day, and you will sit beside that Ergab.
alternate_renderings: And when you have stayed three days, then you shall go down quickly, and come to the place where you did hide yourself when the business was in hand, and shall remain by the stone Ezel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: the mighty Lord who gives avenges to me, disciplining peoples under me,
alternate_renderings: It is God that avenges me, and that brings down the people under me.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And some were saying, Our fields and our vineyards and our houses we are pledging, and we shall get grain and eat.
alternate_renderings: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Samouēl said, What have you done? And Saoul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and you did not come as you ordered in the testimony of the days, and the foreigners were gathered in Machmas,
alternate_renderings: And Samuel said, What have you done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were scattered from me, and that you came not within the days appointed, and that the Philistines gathered themselves together at Michmash;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it was reported to Solomon, saying that Ioab fled to the tent of the Lord, and behold, he holds the horns of the altar. And Solomon sent to Ioab, saying, What has happened to you that you fled to the altar? And Ioab said, Because I feared from before you, and I fled to the Lord. And King Solomon sent Banaiou son of Iodae, saying, Go and kill him and bury him.
alternate_renderings: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of the gatekeepers: sons of Saloum, sons of Ater, sons of Telmon, sons of Akoub, sons of Atita, sons of Sabaou, all together 139.
alternate_renderings: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The fury of dragons is their wine, and the incurable fury of asps.
alternate_renderings: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: thirty golden bowls, two hundred silver bowls, and one thousand other vessels.
alternate_renderings: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And David took the golden bracelets that were upon the servants of Adraazar king of Souba and brought them to Ierousalēm. And Sousakim king of Egypt took them when he came up to Ierousalēm in the days of Roboam son of Solōmōn.
alternate_renderings: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Joshua devoted it and everything that was in the city, from man to woman, from young man to old man, and from calf to beast of burden, by the mouth of the sword.
alternate_renderings: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: On the fifth day, the chief of the sons of Simeon was Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
alternate_renderings: On the fifth day Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai, prince of the children of Simeon, did offer:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And sons of Alphaal: Obed, Messaam, Semmer. This one built Ono and Lod and its villages.
alternate_renderings: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you must keep the charge of the Lord your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his commandments and his ordinances and his judgments, the things written in the law of Moyses, so that you may understand what you will do according to all that I command you.
alternate_renderings: And keep the charge of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do, and anywhere you turn yourself:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be, when Aōd finished presenting the gifts, he sent away those carrying the gifts.
alternate_renderings: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Zebulun did not remove those dwelling in Kedrōn and those dwelling in Enaala, and the Canaanite dwelt in its midst and became subject to tribute.
alternate_renderings: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and from the fields, because the singers built farmsteads for themselves in Ierousalem.
alternate_renderings: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had built them villages round about Jerusalem.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And its redemption from one month old shall be, by valuation, five shekels according to the holy shekel; twenty obols they are.
alternate_renderings: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shall you redeem, according to yours estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall take for yourself from all the foods that you eat, and gather it to yourself, and it shall be for you and for them to eat.
alternate_renderings: And take you unto you of all food that is eaten, and you shall gather it to you; and it shall be for food for you, and for them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and the table and all its utensils,
alternate_renderings: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the showbread,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: They shall utterly destroy nations, and there you shall call them, and they shall sacrifice a sacrifice of righteousness, because the wealth of the sea shall suckle you and the trade of those dwelling on the coast.
alternate_renderings: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Abessalōm said to Chousi, Is this your mercy with your companion? Why did you not go with your companion?
alternate_renderings: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this your kindness to your friend? why went you not with your friend?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And at the door of the tent of testimony you shall sit seven days, day and night, and you shall keep the Lord's charges, so that you may not die. For thus the Lord God commanded me.
alternate_renderings: Therefore shall all of you abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that all of you die not: for so I am commanded.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall make two rings of pure gold under its twisted border. On its two sides you shall make them at the two corners, and they shall be holders for the poles, to carry it by them.
alternate_renderings: And two golden rings shall you make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shall you make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it likewise.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall designate cities for yourselves. They shall be refuges for you, for the slayer to flee there, everyone who struck down a soul unintentionally.
alternate_renderings: Then all of you shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which kills any person at unexpectedly.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And king of Israel gathered prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Shall I go to Ramōth Galaad for battle, or shall I hold back? And they said, Go up, and God will give into hands of king.
alternate_renderings: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: They sacrificed to demons and not to God, to gods they did not know, new recent ones have come whom their fathers did not know.
alternate_renderings: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Heli said to Samouēl, Samouēl, child. And he said, Behold, here I am.
alternate_renderings: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And sons of Merari their brother at the left hand: Aithan son of Kisai son of Abdi son of Maloch,
alternate_renderings: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: They were not wise to understand these things; let them receive them for the coming time.
alternate_renderings: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: You shall not wrong your neighbor, and you shall not rob, and the wage of the hired laborer shall not sleep with you until morning.
alternate_renderings: You shall not defraud your neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with you all night until the morning.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Makelloth begot Samaa. And these also dwelt in Jerusalem in midst of their brothers with their brothers.
alternate_renderings: And Mikloth brings forth Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, opposite to their brethren.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the boundary shall turn to Rama and as far as the spring of Masphassat and the Tyrians, and the boundary shall turn to Iasiph, and its outlet shall be the sea, and from Leb and Echozob,
alternate_renderings: And then the coast turns to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turns to Hosah; and the utmost limit thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: according to all that you asked from the Lord your God in Horeb on the day of the assembly, saying, We shall not add to hear the voice of the Lord our God, and we shall not see this great fire any more, nor indeed die.
alternate_renderings: According to all that you desired of the LORD your God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Blight shall consume all your trees and the produce of your land.
alternate_renderings: All your trees and fruit of your land shall the locust consume.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the excess of plunder that the fighting men plundered from the sheep was six hundred seventy-five thousand.
alternate_renderings: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Ourias comes and entered to him, and David asked concerning the peace of Iōab and concerning the peace of the people and concerning the peace of the war.
alternate_renderings: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Asa took the silver and the gold found in the treasures of the king's house and gave them into the hands of his servants, and King Asa sent them to son of Ader son of Taberemman son of Azin, king of Syria, the one dwelling in Damascus, saying,
alternate_renderings: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his ordinances with all heart and with all soul, to establish the words of this covenant written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
alternate_renderings: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: He shall be with you as a hired worker or a resident. He shall work beside you until the year of release,
alternate_renderings: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with you, and shall serve you unto the year of jubile.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And one son of Abimelech son of Achitōb escaped, and his name was Abiathar, and he fled after David.
alternate_renderings: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Eliezer son of Dōdia from Marisa prophesied against Iōsaphat, saying, Because you made friendship with Ochozias, Lord broke your work, and your ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tharsis.
alternate_renderings: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, the LORD has broken your works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the priests: sons of Iedoua, of house of Iesou, 973.
alternate_renderings: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Ruth said to her mother-in-law, Indeed he also said to me, Stay close with my young men until they finish all the harvest that belongs to me.
alternate_renderings: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, You shall keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: to devise and design, to work gold and silver and bronze, and blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen,
alternate_renderings: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: His father's brother or the son of his father's brother shall redeem him, or one from his own flesh, from his tribe, shall redeem him. But if he prospers in his hands, he may redeem himself.
alternate_renderings: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the sons of Joseph inherited, Ephraim and Manasseh.
alternate_renderings: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: This is the book of the origin of humans. On the day God made Adam, according to the image of God he made him.
alternate_renderings: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And its thickness was a handbreadth, and its rim like rim of cup, carved lily blossoms, holding three thousand measures, and it was finished.
alternate_renderings: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And there shall be a ruler in the beloved, when leaders of peoples are gathered together with the tribes of Israel.
alternate_renderings: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from the tribe of Asher, Basellan and its set-apart lands, and Dabbōn and its set-apart lands,
alternate_renderings: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Lord gave death in Israel, and seventy thousand men fell from Israel.
alternate_renderings: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you are righteous over all things coming upon us, because you did truth, and we sinned.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless you are just in all that is brought upon us; for you have done right, but we have done wickedly:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And all glorious men of Iouda and priests and people of land multiplied to break faith with faithless acts of abominations of nations, and they defiled house of Lord in Ierousalem.
alternate_renderings: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Let all earth fear from before him; let earth be set right and not be shaken.
alternate_renderings: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Remember me, O God, in this, and let not my mercy be wiped out, which I did in house of Lord God.
alternate_renderings: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And battle turned in that day, and king of Israel was standing on chariot until evening against Syria, and he died at setting of sun.
alternate_renderings: And the battle increased that day: nevertheless the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And sons of Levites took ark of God as Moyses commanded by word of God, according to writing, with carrying-poles upon them.
