rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Now then rise and set out, you, and pass through the Ravine of Zaret. And we passed through the Ravine of Zaret.
alternate_renderings: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And with you are workers in abundance, craftsmen and builders of stone and carpenters of wood and every wise man in every work,
alternate_renderings: Moreover there are workmen with you in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: "Tell the sons of Israel to take contributions for me. From everyone whose heart deems it good, you shall take my contributions."
alternate_renderings: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that gives it willingly with his heart all of you shall take my offering.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he built city all around and fought and took city.
alternate_renderings: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And these were singers, chiefs of fathers of the Levites, appointed by courses, because day and night the works were upon them.
alternate_renderings: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he set all people, each with his weapons, from shoulder of house on right to shoulder on left, by altar and by house, around king.
alternate_renderings: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if an unjust witness stands against a man, charging him with ungodliness,
alternate_renderings: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: It shall not be poured on human flesh, and according to this composition you shall not make any for yourselves in the same way. It is holy, and it shall be holiness for you.
alternate_renderings: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall all of you make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And look, as though out of the river seven cows were coming up, beautiful in appearance and choice in flesh, and they were grazing among the reeds.
alternate_renderings: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured cattle and well fed; and they fed in a meadow.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they sent to me according to this word four times, and I sent them according to these things.
alternate_renderings: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king answered and said, Give the child to the one who said, Give him to her, and by death do not put him to death. She is his mother.
alternate_renderings: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he cast Adam out and settled him opposite the garden of delight, and he stationed the Cherubim and the flaming turning sword to guard the way of the tree of life.
alternate_renderings: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: "The animal from the flock shall be for you unblemished, male, a year old. You shall take it from the lambs and from the kids."
alternate_renderings: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: all of you shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And on that day he struck down the foreigners from Machmas, and the people grew very weary.
alternate_renderings: And they stroke the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Machir took a wife for Amphin and Maphin, and name of his sister was Moocha, and name of the second was Salpaad, and daughters were born to Salpaad.
alternate_renderings: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And in that time there is no peace to one going out and to one coming in, because terror of Lord is upon all dwelling in lands.
alternate_renderings: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And of the chosen ones of Israel not even one was missing. And they appeared in the place of God, and they ate and drank.
alternate_renderings: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And your servant used to strike both the bear and the lion, and this uncircumcised foreigner will be like one of them. Will I not go and strike him and remove today reproach from Israel? Because who is this uncircumcised one, who has reproached the battle-line of the living God?
alternate_renderings: Your servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he has defied the armies of the living God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And in God: morning light, when the sun rises at morning, a morning not passed over from brightness, and as grass from the earth after rain.
alternate_renderings: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: chief Kenez, chief Thaiman, chief Mabsar,
alternate_renderings: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if flesh has in its skin a burn of fire, and the healed part of the burn becomes a bright spot, white tinged red or pure white,
alternate_renderings: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burns have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And whatever remains of need for house of your God, whatever seems to you to give, you shall give from houses of treasury of the king.
alternate_renderings: And whatsoever more shall be necessary for the house of your God, which you shall have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Elisaie spoke to the woman whose son he restored to life, saying, Rise and go, you and your house, and sojourn where you may sojourn, because the Lord has called for famine upon the land, and it has come upon the land seven years.
alternate_renderings: Then spoke Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go you and yours household, and sojourn where ever you can sojourn: for the LORD has called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Every place on which you step with the track of your feet, I will give it to you, in the way I told Moses.
alternate_renderings: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the spirit of the king ceased from going out after Abessalōm, because he was comforted over Amnōn, because he died.
alternate_renderings: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king went out and all his servants on foot, and they stood at the far house.
alternate_renderings: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And after flaying the whole burnt offering, they shall divide it by limbs.
alternate_renderings: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he lifted his face to the window and saw her and said, Who are you? Come down with me. And two eunuchs looked down toward him.
alternate_renderings: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: wisdom and understanding I give to you, and wealth and riches and glory I will give to you such as none among kings before you had, and after you there shall not be thus.
alternate_renderings: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto you; and I will give you riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before you, neither shall there any after you have the like.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they gave their hands to put out their wives, and for their trespass a ram from the sheep for their trespass.
alternate_renderings: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Iōsaphat was becoming greater and greater on high, and he built dwellings in Iouda and fortified cities.
alternate_renderings: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: then with the bull he shall bring a sacrifice of fine flour, three tenths, prepared with oil, one half of a hin.
alternate_renderings: Then shall he bring with a bullock a food offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Men of Arama and Gabaa: 621.
alternate_renderings: The men of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he built the innermost court, three rows of hewn stone and a row of worked cedar all around. And he built a curtain for the court of the porch of the house that was before the nave.
alternate_renderings: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the man whoever disobeys you and whoever does not listen to your words in whatever you command him, let him die. But be strong and act like a man.
alternate_renderings: Whosoever he be that does rebel against your commandment, and will not hearken unto your words in all that you command him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they came as far as threshing floor, and Oza stretched out his hand to grasp ark, because calf turned it aside.
alternate_renderings: And when they came unto the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Any man of the sons of Israel or of the newcomers dwelling among you who slaughters a calf or a sheep or a goat in the camp, or who slaughters it outside the camp,
alternate_renderings: Whosoever there be of the house of Israel, that kills an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that kills it out of the camp,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Samaias the Gabaonite, mighty among thirty and over thirty,
alternate_renderings: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and the sin that they sinned in it becomes known to them, then the assembly shall bring a calf from the cattle, without blemish, for sin, and they shall bring it to the doors of the tent of testimony.
alternate_renderings: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the altars on the roof of the upper room of Achaz, which the kings of Judah made, and the altars which Manassēs made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, the king tore down and broke up there and threw their dust into the wadi Kedrōn.
alternate_renderings: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And a man who strikes a human life, and it dies, let him surely be put to death.
alternate_renderings: And he that kills any man shall surely be put to death.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And all the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, Would that we had died in the land of Egypt, or would that we had died in this wilderness.
alternate_renderings: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: a nation shameless in face, which shall not marvel at the face of an elder, and the young it shall not pity,
alternate_renderings: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor show favour to the young:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Now then, let me remain as a servant to my lord in place of the child, but let the child go up with his brothers.
alternate_renderings: Now therefore, I pray you, let your servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: But high places still existed, and people still did not direct heart toward Lord God of their fathers.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the chief jailer assigned them to Joseph, and he attended them. And they were some days under guard.
alternate_renderings: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Atharsatha said to them not to eat from the holy of holies until a priest might arise with the lights and the perfections.
alternate_renderings: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And a man I will not destroy for you from my altar, to fail his eyes and make his soul melt away, and everyone remaining of your house shall fall by the sword of men.
alternate_renderings: And the man of yours, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume yours eyes, and to grieve yours heart: and all the increase of yours house shall die in the flower of their age.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And their number with their brothers, taught to sing to Lord, every one understanding, was two hundred eighty-eight.
alternate_renderings: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord delivered it into the hand of Israel, and he took it on that day and killed it with the edge of the sword, and every breathing thing in it they killed in the way they did to Lachish.
alternate_renderings: And they took it on that day, and stroke it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: sons of Bakbouk, sons of Akipha, sons of Arour,
alternate_renderings: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And this shall be the ordinance of the killer who flees there and lives: whoever strikes his neighbor unintentionally, this one not hating him before yesterday or the third day,
alternate_renderings: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso kills his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: You shall not do injustice to the wages of the poor and needy, whether from your brothers or from the proselytes in your cities.
alternate_renderings: You shall not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy, whether he be of your brethren, or of your strangers that are in your land within your gates:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And there Salomon brought up upon bronze altar before Lord, the one in tent, and brought up upon it one thousand whole burnt offerings.
alternate_renderings: And Solomon went up thither to the brazen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Abia pursued after Ieroboam and seized from him cities: Baithēl and its villages, and Isana and its villages, and Ephrōn and its villages.
alternate_renderings: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephraim with the towns thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And not so, because thus says the Lord: The bed on which you went up there, you shall not come down from it, because by death you will die. And Elijah went and spoke to them.
alternate_renderings: Now therefore thus says the LORD, You shall not come down from that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die. And Elijah departed.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: to Abraham as a holding, before the sons of Heth and all who entered into the city.
alternate_renderings: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he brought the sacrifice and filled his hands from it and placed it on the altar, apart from the morning whole burnt offering.
alternate_renderings: And he brought the food offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king called Siba, the young servant of Saoul, and said to him, All things whatever belong to Saoul and to all his house I have given to the son of your lord.
alternate_renderings: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto your master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And on the third day it was reported to Laban the Syrian that Jacob had fled,
alternate_renderings: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Like an eagle sheltering its nest and longing over its young, spreading its wings, it received them and took them up on its back.
alternate_renderings: As an eagle stirs up her nest, flutteres over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them, bears them on her wings:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because of this I will confess you, Lord, among the nations, and to your name I will sing psalms,
alternate_renderings: Therefore I will give thanks unto you, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto your name.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said, A word is mine to you. And she said to him, Speak.
alternate_renderings: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto you. And she said, Say on.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and the Chasloniem, from where the Phylistieim came out, and the Caphtorieim.
alternate_renderings: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be at a two-year cycle of days, they were shearing for Abessalōm at Belasōr by Ephraim, and Abessalōm called all the sons of the king.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And every man of Iouda returned to Ierousalem, and Iōsaphat leading them, with great gladness, because Lord gladdened them from their enemies.
alternate_renderings: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Caleb son of Jephonne utterly destroyed from there the three sons of Anak, Sousi and Tholmi and Achima.
alternate_renderings: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: the tent and the hangings and the coverings and the rings and the bars and the posts,
alternate_renderings: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his clasps, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, Moses spoke to all the sons of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded him to them,
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be at midday, Elijah the Thesbite mocked them and said, Call with a loud voice, because he is god. Surely he has talk on his mind, or perhaps he is occupied, or perhaps he sleeps and will awaken.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or possibly he sleeps, and must be awaked.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Now run to meet her and say, Is there peace for you? Is there peace for your husband? Is there peace for the boy? And she said, Peace.
alternate_renderings: Run now, I pray you, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with you? is it well with your husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Abennēr added still, saying to Asaēl, Stand away from me, lest I strike you to the ground. And how shall I lift my face to Iōab your brother? And where are these things? Turn toward Iōab your brother.
alternate_renderings: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn you aside from following me: wherefore should I strike you to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab your brother?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Any man to anyone of his own flesh shall not come near to uncover nakedness. I am the Lord.
alternate_renderings: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they set out first by the word of the Lord by Moses' hand.
alternate_renderings: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: then it shall be, if the ungodly one is worthy of blows, you shall make him sit before the judges, and they shall whip him before them according to his ungodliness, by number.
alternate_renderings: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: But if the natives of the land by overlooking overlook that man with their eyes when he gives of his seed to a ruler, so as not to put him to death,

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And there was hail, and the fire flaming in the hail, and the hail was very, very great, such as had not happened in Egypt from the time a nation came to be upon it.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And everyone offering a silver or bronze contribution brought the Lord's contributions, and those with whom incorruptible wood was found for all the works of preparation brought it.
alternate_renderings: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the man who does not hear whatever the prophet speaks in my name, I will exact it from him.

chosen_rendering: On that day then Dauid first appointed by hand of Asaph and his brothers to praise Lord.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and the Lord chose you today to become for him a people of special possession, just as he said to you, to keep all his commands,
alternate_renderings: And the LORD has stand as a witness to you this day to be his exclusive people, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Not so with my servant Moses; in all my house he is faithful.
alternate_renderings: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the foreigners again added to go up and fell in the Valley of the Titans.
alternate_renderings: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: so that these may exist for you as a sign lying there forever, so that when your son asks you tomorrow, saying, What are these stones to you?
alternate_renderings: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean all of you by these stones?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the nave in front was forty cubits.
alternate_renderings: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: All the cities for the sons of Merari according to their clans, the ones left over from the tribe of Levi, and their boundaries came to be twelve cities.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And concubine of Chaleb, Mocha, bore Saber and Tharchna.
alternate_renderings: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: those counted from the tribe of Manasseh: thirty-two thousand two hundred.
alternate_renderings: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Look, this city is near for me to flee there, and it is small, and there I shall be preserved. Is it not small? And my life shall live because of you.
alternate_renderings: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And brother will disregard brother, as in war, though none chases, and you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
alternate_renderings: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursues: and all of you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it happened on such a day, Joseph entered the house to do his work, and none of the people of the house was inside.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: I declare to you today that with destruction you shall perish, and you shall certainly not be long-lived on the land that the Lord your God gives you, into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it.
alternate_renderings: I denounce unto you this day, that all of you shall surely perish, and that all of you shall not prolong your days upon the land, where you pass over Jordan to go to possess it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: From all your gifts you shall remove the Lord's contribution, from all the firstfruits, the holy part from it.
alternate_renderings: Out of all your gifts all of you shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And David sought God concerning the little boy, and David fasted a fast and entered and lodged in sackcloth on the ground.
alternate_renderings: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the angel of God stood in the vineyards' furrows, a fence here and a fence there.
alternate_renderings: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And with the chosen one you will be chosen, and with the crooked you will be twisted.
alternate_renderings: With the pure you will show yourself pure; and with the perverse you will show yourself unpleasing.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the people was not willing to hear Samouēl, and they said to him, No, but a king shall be over us.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless the people refused to obey the voice of Samuel; and they said, Nay; but we will have a king over us;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saoul was sitting on the edge of the hill under the pomegranate tree in Magdōn, and about six hundred men were with him.
alternate_renderings: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people that were with him were about six hundred men;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And she said, Your servant found favor in your eyes. And the woman went on her way and entered into her lodging and ate with her husband and drank, and her face did not fall any more.
alternate_renderings: And she said, Let yours handmaid find grace in your sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And to Joseph he said, His land is from the blessings of the Lord, from seasons of heaven and dew and from springs of depths below,
alternate_renderings: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that couches beneath,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And stand in house according to divisions of houses of your fathers, for your brothers, sons of people, and share of father-house for Levites.
alternate_renderings: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: You said, Behold, you struck Idoumaia, and your heavy heart lifts you up. Now sit in your house. Why provoke evil and fall, you and Iouda with you?
alternate_renderings: You says, Lo, you have smitten the Edomites; and yours heart lifts you up to boast: abide now at home; why should you meddle to yours hurt, that you should fall, even you, and Judah with you?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because many of assembly had not sanctified themselves, and Levites were to sacrifice passover for everyone not able to sanctify to Lord.
alternate_renderings: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Yet good matters were found in you, because you removed groves from land of Iouda and directed your heart to seek Lord.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have taken away the groves out of the land, and have prepared yours heart to seek God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: A thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, from all the tribes of Israel, send out to array for battle.
alternate_renderings: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall all of you send to the war.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and ten leaders with him, one leader from each fathers' house from all the tribes of Israel; these were heads of fathers' houses, commanders of thousands in Israel.
alternate_renderings: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the ordinance of the priest from the people, everyone sacrificing, was this: the servant of the priest came while the meat was boiling, and a three-pronged flesh-hook was in his hand,
alternate_renderings: And the priest's custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fork of three teeth in his hand;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And David said to him, Whose are you, and from where are you? And the Egyptian young man said, I am slave of an Amalēkite man, and my lord left me because I became sick, today the third day.
alternate_renderings: And David said unto him, To whom belong you? and whence are you? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I fell sick.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Simeon and Levi are brothers. They accomplished injustice from their own choosing.
alternate_renderings: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saloum begot Iechemian, and Iechemias begot Elisama.
alternate_renderings: And Shallum brings forth Jekamiah, and Jekamiah brings forth Elishama.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Balla, Rachel's servant-girl, conceived and bore a son to Jacob.
alternate_renderings: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the servants of the king said to the king, According to all things whatever my lord the king chooses, behold, your servants.
alternate_renderings: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, your servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and to the kings near great Sidon in the hill country and in the Raba opposite Keneroth and in the plain and in Napheddor,

chosen_rendering: And ark of God stayed in house of Abeddara three months, and God blessed Abeddaram and all his things.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Egyptians afflicted them, and the Lord struck Egypt with the things he did among them, and after these things he brought you out.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: But the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice you; speak no more unto me of this matter.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And their pillars twenty, and their twenty bronze bases, and their hooks and fastenings of silver.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: to Kōs seventh, to Abia eighth,

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for you shall surely die, Jonathan.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And upon her was a full-length tunic, because thus the king’s virgin daughters were clothed with their robes. And his attendant brought her out and barred the door behind her.
alternate_renderings: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if you sacrifice a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
alternate_renderings: And if all of you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, all of you shall offer it at your own will.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Salman fathered Boos, and Boos fathered Ōbēd,
alternate_renderings: And Salmon brings forth Boaz, and Boaz brings forth Obed,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And after death of Iōdae, rulers of Iouda came and bowed to king; then king listened to them.
alternate_renderings: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made reverence to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Now after those many days the king of Egypt died. And the Lord said to Moses in Midian, 'Go, depart into Egypt, for all seeking your life have died.'
alternate_renderings: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought your life.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because the Lord will judge his people and be comforted over his servants, for he saw them weakened and worn out in confinement and abandoned.
alternate_renderings: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And these are the things that you shall offer upon the altar: two year-old flawless lambs each day upon the altar continually, a continual offering.
alternate_renderings: Now this is that which you shall offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall not make your lives abominable among all the creeping things that creep on the earth, and you shall not be defiled by them, and you shall not become unclean by them.
alternate_renderings: All of you shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps, neither shall all of you make yourselves unclean with them, that all of you should be defiled thereby.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Reuben, my firstborn, you are my strength and the beginning of my children, hard to bear and hard, self-willed.
alternate_renderings: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord handed them over to you, and you shall do to them just as I commanded you.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that all of you may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And because Pharaoh's dream was doubled twice, the thing will be true from God, and God will hasten to do it.
alternate_renderings: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the foreigners were afraid and said, These gods have come to them into the camp. Woe to us, Lord, rescue us today, because such a thing has not happened yesterday or the day before.
alternate_renderings: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God has come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there has not been such a thing in time past.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they shall put upon it a blue leather covering and spread over it an all-blue cloth above, and they shall put in its carrying poles.
alternate_renderings: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And with your neighbor's wife you shall not give the bed of your seed, to defile yourself with her.
alternate_renderings: Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbour's wife, to defile yourself with her.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And who am I, and who are my people, that we grew strong to be willing to you in this way? Because all things are yours, and from your things we gave to you.
alternate_renderings: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of you, and of yours own have we given you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And his son: Geseel, Aemiachi, Zapha, Zaira, and Eserael.
alternate_renderings: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because in you I will run as a raider, and in my God I will leap over a wall.
alternate_renderings: For by you I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: But if someone attacks his neighbor to kill him with deceit, and he flees to my altar, you shall take him from there to put him to death.
alternate_renderings: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; you shall take him from mine altar, that he may die.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if after this you go at odds with me and are unwilling to listen to me, I will add blows to you sevenfold according to your sins.
alternate_renderings: And if all of you walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and twenty golden bowls worth one thousand chamanim, and vessels of shining good bronze, choice as gold.
alternate_renderings: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And now, Lord, we give thanks to you and praise name of your boasting.
alternate_renderings: Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And your flocks he will tithe, and you will be his servants.
alternate_renderings: He will take the tenth of your sheep: and all of you shall be his servants.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saoul turned back from pursuing after David and went to meet the foreigners. Because of this that place was called Divided Rock.
alternate_renderings: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they gave him seventy silver pieces from the house of Baal-covenant, and with them Abimelech hired empty and stunned men, and they went after him.
alternate_renderings: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because all the days that the son of Iessai lives upon the earth, your kingdom will not be established. Now therefore, send and take the young man, because he is a son of death.
alternate_renderings: For as long as the son of Jesse lives upon the ground, you shall not be established, nor your kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said, Do not leave us, because for this reason you were with us in the wilderness, and you shall be among us an elder.
alternate_renderings: And he said, Leave us not, I pray you; forasmuch as you know how we are to camp in the wilderness, and you may be to us instead of eyes.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Banaias son of Iodae, son of mighty man, his deeds were many, above Kabasael. He struck two sons of Ariel of Moab, and he went down and struck lion in pit on snowy day.
alternate_renderings: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you will look for the good and upright among the sons of your lord and set him on the throne of his father, and fight for the house of your lord.
alternate_renderings: Look even out the best and fittest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if a person redeems his tithe in redeeming, he shall add the fifth part to it, and it shall be his.
alternate_renderings: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord drove out the Amorite and all the nations dwelling in the land from before us. Therefore we also will serve the Lord, for he is our God.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD drove out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: But Noah found favor before the Lord God.
alternate_renderings: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: For I will honor you greatly, and whatever you say I will do for you. And come, curse this people for me.
alternate_renderings: For I will promote you unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever you says unto me: come therefore, I pray you, curse me this people.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Thēmar said to him, No, my brother, because this last evil is greater than the first, which you did with me, by sending me away. And Amnōn was not willing to hear her voice.
alternate_renderings: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that you did unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: All these were sons of Jektan.
alternate_renderings: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Jacob saw Laban's face, and look, it was not toward him as yesterday and the third day.
alternate_renderings: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And many works came to him in Iouda, and mighty men of war were strong in Ierousalem.
alternate_renderings: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: with bow in right hand and in left hand, slingers with stones and arrows, from brothers of Saul, from Beniamin.
alternate_renderings: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said to him, No, but going up, we shall go up and inherit it, because being able, we shall be able against them.
alternate_renderings: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: The God of Israel says; the guard of Israel spoke to me: I will speak a parable. In humanity, how will you make strong the fear of God?
alternate_renderings: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, He that rules over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of Iediou: Amadia second, Iaziēl third, Iokom fourth.
alternate_renderings: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Out of the lot you shall divide their inheritance between many and few.
alternate_renderings: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And those near the Kenite had separated from the sons of Jōbab, son-in-law of Moses, and he pitched his tent by the oak of those resting, which is near Kedes.
alternate_renderings: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the ship of Chiram, carrying the gold from Souphir, brought very many worked timbers and costly stone.
alternate_renderings: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the woman went and did, and she and he and her children were eating.
alternate_renderings: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Noe. Sons of Noe: Sem, Cham, Iapheth.
alternate_renderings: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it will be on the day of your going out and crossing the torrent Kedron, knowing you will know that you will die by death. Your blood will be on your head. And the king made him swear on that day.
alternate_renderings: For it shall be, that on the day you go out, and pass over the brook Kidron, you shall know for certain that you shall surely die: your blood shall be upon yours own head.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And his servants said to him, What is this word that you have done? For the little boy, while he was still alive, you were fasting and weeping and keeping watch, and when the little boy died, you rose and ate bread and have drunk.
alternate_renderings: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that you have done? you did fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, you did rise and eat bread.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And having gone out, it did not return until the water dried from the earth.
alternate_renderings: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth back and forth, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And from his brothers he took five men and set them before Pharaoh.
alternate_renderings: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

alternate_renderings: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: those counted from the tribe of Benjamin: thirty-five thousand four hundred.
alternate_renderings: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And take great care to love the Lord your God.
alternate_renderings: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that all of you love the LORD your God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Nor is it beyond the sea, saying, Who will cross over for us to the far side of the sea and take it for us and make it heard to us, and we will do it?
alternate_renderings: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Katanath and Nabaal and Symoon and Jericho and Baithman.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he will turn back upon you every evil pain of Egypt that you feared before them, and they shall cling in you.
alternate_renderings: Moreover he will bring upon you all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they shall cleave unto you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: to Ochchoppha thirteenth, to Isbaal fourteenth,
alternate_renderings: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he established the torrents to make Ar a dwelling, and it lies against the borders of Moab.
alternate_renderings: And at the stream of the brooks that goes down to the dwelling of Ar, and lies upon the border of Moab.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he built cities for himself, and possession of sheep and cattle in abundance, because Lord gave him very much possession.
alternate_renderings: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: besides the levies of the subjects and the merchants and all the kings from beyond and the satraps of the land.
alternate_renderings: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the trade of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord added and called, Samouēl, Samouēl. And he went to Heli a second time and said, Behold, here I am, because you called me. And he said, I did not call you; go back, sleep.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for you did call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the calf for sin and the he-goat for sin, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, they shall carry outside the camp and burn them with fire, their skins and their flesh and their dung.
alternate_renderings: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they returned to him, and he was sitting in Ierichō, and Elisaie said, Did I not tell you, Do not go?

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: Now therefore come you, let us make a covenant, I and you; and let it be for a witness between me and you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as you have said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for you and for your son.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: Whereas you have searched all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? set it here before my brethren and your brethren, that they may judge between us both.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: But all of you shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and it is reported to you, and you search it out very carefully, and behold, the matter has truly happened, this abomination has occurred in Israel,
alternate_renderings: And it be told you, and you have heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.
