rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord your God himself will destroy them from before you until they perish, and he will send to them the wild beasts until he destroys them and their kings from before you, and you shall inherit their land just as the Lord your God spoke to you.
alternate_renderings: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and all of you shall possess their land, as the LORD your God has promised unto you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: He is Lord our God; in all earth are his judgments.
alternate_renderings: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And sons of wife of Idouia, sister of Nachem: Dalia father of Keila and Semeion father of Ioman. And sons of Naem father of Keila: Agarmi and Esthemoe Machathi.
alternate_renderings: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Only because in provoking you provoked the enemies of the Lord by this word, indeed the son born to you will surely die.
alternate_renderings: Nevertheless, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the enemies of the LORD to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto you shall surely die.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And strong kings were over Ierousalem, ruling all the west beyond the River, and full taxes and tribute were given to them.
alternate_renderings: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Sons of Selom son of Iouda: Er father of Lecha and Laada father of Maresa and generations of houses of workers of fine linen for the house of Esoba.
alternate_renderings: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And twelve lions standing there on six steps, on this side and that side. Thus it had not been done in any kingdom.
alternate_renderings: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he struck Nomba, the city of the priests, by the mouth of the sword, from man to woman, from infant to nursing child, and ox and donkey and sheep.
alternate_renderings: And Nob, the city of the priests, stroke he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and infants, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And for the doorway of the debir he made doors of juniper wood, and the doorposts were fivefold.
alternate_renderings: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because this is not an empty word for you, because this is your life, and because of this word you shall be long-lived on the land into which you are crossing the Jordan there to inherit it.
alternate_renderings: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing all of you shall prolong your days in the land, where all of you go over Jordan to possess it.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Abram set out, and going on, camped in the wilderness.
alternate_renderings: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: but when the gate was being shut in the dark, the men went out. I do not know where they have gone. Pursue after them, if you will overtake them.
alternate_renderings: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: where the men went I know not: pursue after them quickly; for all of you shall overtake them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they took captive all their persons and all their baggage and their wives, and they plundered whatever was in the city and whatever was in the houses.
alternate_renderings: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: So he set over them overseers of labor to afflict them in their labors; and they built fortified cities for Pharaoh: Pithom, Ramesses, and On, which is Heliopolis.
alternate_renderings: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the Lord destroyed from before you great and strong nations, and no one stood against you until this day.
alternate_renderings: For the LORD has driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man has been able to stand before you unto this day.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And David gathered again every young man from Israel, about seventy thousand.
alternate_renderings: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Be courageous and strong. Do not fear, nor be cowardly, nor terrified before their face, because the Lord your God, the one going before with you, will certainly not leave you nor forsake you.
alternate_renderings: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD your God, he it is that does go with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau, and to Esau I gave Mount Seir for his inheritance, and Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt and became there a great and numerous and strong nation.
alternate_renderings: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they were bringing each his gifts: golden vessels and clothing and myrrh and spices and horses and mules, according to year by year.
alternate_renderings: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said, And now, as you say, so it will be. The one with whom the cup is found will be my servant, but you will be innocent.
alternate_renderings: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and all of you shall be blameless.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Will sheep and cattle be slaughtered for them, and will it be enough for them? Or will every fish of the sea be gathered for them, and will it be enough for them?
alternate_renderings: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And all the assembly answered and said, Great is this word of yours upon us to do.
alternate_renderings: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As you have said, so must we do.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: then the one whose house it is shall come and report to the priest, saying, Something like a mark has appeared to me in the house.
alternate_renderings: And he that owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seems to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the sons of Israel did just as Moses instructed them, and they asked from the Egyptians silver and gold vessels and clothing.
alternate_renderings: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Joseph set it for them as an ordinance until this day on the land of Egypt, reserving a fifth part for Pharaoh, except only the land of the priests, which did not belong to Pharaoh.
alternate_renderings: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part, except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And in cities of Ephraim and Manassē and Symeōn and Nephthali and in their places round about.
alternate_renderings: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And these wine skins that we filled new, these have burst, and our garments and our sandals have worn out because of the very long road.
alternate_renderings: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they were teaching in Iouda, and with them was book of law of Lord, and they went through cities of Iouda and taught people.
alternate_renderings: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And why do you twist the minds of the sons of Israel, so that they do not cross into the land that the Lord gives them?
alternate_renderings: And wherefore discourage all of you the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and now, behold, they attempt against us, to come cast us out from our inheritance which you gave us.
alternate_renderings: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Chiram brought to Solomon one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
alternate_renderings: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Dauid was girded with linen robe, and all Levites carrying ark of covenant of Lord, and singers, and Chonenia chief of songs of singers; and upon Dauid was linen robe.
alternate_renderings: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And on the hem of the robe below you shall make pomegranates like blossoming pomegranate fruit, of blue and purple and spun scarlet and woven fine linen, on the hem of the robe all around; and golden pomegranates and bells all around between them.
alternate_renderings: And beneath upon the hem of it you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Your clothes did not wear out from upon you, and your feet did not become calloused, behold, these forty years.
alternate_renderings: Your raiment waxed not old upon you, neither did your foot swell, these forty years.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because everyone doing these things, everyone doing injustice, is an abomination to the Lord your God.
alternate_renderings: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD your God.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: then hear from heaven their petition and their prayer and do their justice.
alternate_renderings: Then hear you from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the king made the worked timbers into supports for the house of the Lord and for the house of the king and lyres and harps for the singers. Such worked timbers had not come upon the earth nor been seen anywhere until this day.
alternate_renderings: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Joseph commanded that their containers be filled with grain and that each man's money be returned into his sack and that provisions for the road be given to them. And it was done for them in this way.
alternate_renderings: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they hurried, and each brought down his bag to the ground, and each opened his bag.
alternate_renderings: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Then the sons of Israel set out from Sokchoth and camped at Othom by the wilderness.
alternate_renderings: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saoul inquired through the Lord, and the Lord did not answer him in dreams and in manifestations and in prophets.
alternate_renderings: And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance was like the appearance of crystal.
alternate_renderings: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Remember Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, your servants, to whom you swore by yourself. Do not look upon the hardness of this people and their ungodly deeds and their sins,
alternate_renderings: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Now Rachel had taken the idols and thrown them among the camel packs and sat on them.
alternate_renderings: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: In the second year of Iosaphat, Achaab son of Ambri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Besides the continual morning whole burnt offering, which is a continual whole burnt offering.
alternate_renderings: All of you shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they shall be abominations to you. From their flesh you shall not eat, and their carcasses you shall abhor.
alternate_renderings: They shall be even an abomination unto you; all of you shall not eat of their flesh, but all of you shall have their carcasses in abomination.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Will you not inherit whatever Chamos your god caused you to inherit? And all that the Lord our God inherited from before us, these things we will inherit.
alternate_renderings: Will not you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: This is the law for every mark of skin-disease and scaly patch,
alternate_renderings: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scab,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall make a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice kneaded in oil, a fourth of a hin.
alternate_renderings: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a food offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And this exalted house, everyone passing by it will be astonished and say, For what reason did Lord do thus to this land and to this house?
alternate_renderings: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passes by it; so that he shall say, Why has the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: "And in the abundance of your glory you crushed the adversaries; you sent out your wrath, and it devoured them like stubble."

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of an unicorn (p. ox): he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he would strike the land and would not keep alive man and woman, and he took flocks and herds and donkeys and camels and clothing, and they returned and came to Anchous.
alternate_renderings: And David stroke the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: A man who curses God shall bear sin.
alternate_renderings: And you shall speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

alternate_renderings: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you will eat old stores, even very old stores, and you will clear out the old before the new.
alternate_renderings: And all of you shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And Saul spoke to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if many years remain, according to these he shall pay his redemption from the silver of his sale.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who has with his hands fulfilled that which he spoke with his mouth to my father David, saying,

alternate_renderings: And they said unto Moses, Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacks not one man of us.

chosen_rendering: And they shall spread over it a scarlet cloth and cover it with a blue leather covering and put through it the carrying poles.
alternate_renderings: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Saoul and the men of Israel gather and camp in the valley, and they arrange themselves for war opposite the foreigners.
alternate_renderings: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray you, with me unto another place, from whence you may see them: you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And you shall not offer on it different incense, or an offering, or a sacrifice, and you shall not pour a drink offering on it.

chosen_rendering: And the five satraps of the foreigners saw and returned to Ascalon on that day.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the one sending away the he-goat that has been set apart for release shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and after this shall enter into the camp.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, is Passover to the Lord.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Aimath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spoke by the hand of his servant Iōnas son of Amathi, the prophet from Gethchober.

chosen_rendering: And around the house of God they encamped, because the guard was upon them, and they were over the keys, to open the doors of the sanctuary morning by morning.
alternate_renderings: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he too made high places in cities of Iouda and prostituted inhabitants of Ierousalem and led Iouda astray.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And I said to you, Do not be terrified, and do not fear them.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: to Phetaia nineteenth, to Ezekēl twentieth,
alternate_renderings: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Because from Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and one preserved from Mount Siōn. The zeal of the Lord of forces will do this.
alternate_renderings: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And he said to judges, See what you do, because you do not judge for man, but for Lord, and matters of judgment are with you.
alternate_renderings: And said to the judges, Take heed what all of you do: for all of you judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they said to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, The land that we spied out is very, very good.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Laban gave to Leah his daughter Zelpha his servant-girl as servant-girl for her.
alternate_renderings: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And to Abdedom, sons: Samaias firstborn, Iōzabad second, Iōaa third, Sōchar fourth, Nathanaēl fifth,
alternate_renderings: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And this is the law of the one who has vowed: on whatever day he completes the days of his vow, he shall bring himself to the doors of the tent of testimony.
alternate_renderings: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they sacrificed on that day great sacrifices and rejoiced, because God gladdened them greatly, and their wives and their children rejoiced, and rejoicing in Ierousalem was heard from far away.
alternate_renderings: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even far off.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: While he was still speaking with them, look, Rachel daughter of Laban was coming with her father's sheep, for she was shepherding her father's sheep.
alternate_renderings: And while he yet spoke with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she kept them.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Blessed your men; blessed these servants of yours standing before you continually and hearing your wisdom.
alternate_renderings: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, which stand continually before you, and hear your wisdom.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they set out from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at the Tombs of Desire.
alternate_renderings: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Then they said these things to them: What are names of the men building this city?

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the word was right in the eyes of Abessalom and in the eyes of all the elders of Israel.
alternate_renderings: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and Sekelak and Macharim and Sethennak,
alternate_renderings: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Adad died, and the chiefs of Edom were: chief Thamana, chief Gola, chief Ietheth,
alternate_renderings: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Behold, we are slaves today, and the land which you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit,

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they stationed gatekeepers at gates of house of Lord, and no unclean person in any matter shall enter.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Watch yourselves lest your heart turn aside and you transgress and serve other gods and bow to them,

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: From sons of Phares, chief of all commanders of force for first month.
alternate_renderings: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Zebulun will dwell by the sea, and he will be by a harbor of ships, and he will stretch out as far as Sidon.
alternate_renderings: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: Then another king arose over Egypt who did not know Joseph.
alternate_renderings: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And Bersabee said, Good. I will speak to the king concerning you.
alternate_renderings: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for you unto the king.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: He shall eat an equal portion, besides the sale according to patrimony.
alternate_renderings: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which comes of the sale of his patrimony.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah opposite to his chamber.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: and one-third in house of king, and one-third at middle gate, and all people in courts of house of Lord.
alternate_renderings: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And they plundered the women of Midian and their baggage and their cattle and all their possessions and all their force they plundered.
alternate_renderings: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: His force, the ones counted, was fifty-four thousand four hundred.
alternate_renderings: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And the sounds of the trumpet kept advancing, growing much stronger. Moses was speaking, and God answered him with a voice.
alternate_renderings: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And I will send against you the wild beasts of the land, and they will devour you and destroy your cattle and make you few, and your roads will be desolate.
alternate_renderings: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: to distinguish between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean,
alternate_renderings: And that all of you may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: For if you turn back and attach yourselves to these nations left over with you and make marriages with them and mingle with them and they with you,

chosen_rendering: And Obed begot Ieou, and Ieou begot Azarian.
alternate_renderings: And Obed brings forth Jehu, and Jehu brings forth Azariah,
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

alternate_renderings: And you shall do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall show you; and you shall observe to do according to all that they inform you:
rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And it came to be when she went in, she urged him to ask from her father for the field, and she groaned upon the pack animal and cried out from the pack animal, You gave me into a south land. And Caleb said to her, What is wrong with you?

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

chosen_rendering: And if he brings from the birds an offering as a gift to the Lord, he shall bring his gift from the turtledoves or from the pigeons.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.

rationale: Keeps Septuagint verse wording at this numbering point rather than the Masoretic wording.
